angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,776,818 km at 162.95 pc = 0.15 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1367 +/- 0.0449 mas (same row, RUWE 1.26): 162.95 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.554 +/- 0.056 solar radii from Jofré et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 202772 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract): 1,776,818 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.721 +/- 0.054 solar masses from Jofré et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 202772 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6442 +/- 10 K from Jofré et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 202772 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Jofré et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 202772 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-202772-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.859, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 202772 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.232 dex, from Jofré et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 202772 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.00945, from Jofré et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 202772 A (pscomppars): age 1.63 Gyr, from Jofré et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 202772 A (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.75 km/s, from Jofré et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.544.3994J/abstract)
